runtimeResult.reason: Every external concept that passed curation already has a concrete home in the accepted M3 runtime wave. Creating parallel records would duplicate the same player decisions. M4 closes provenance and rejection boundaries without adding filler.

AdmiralArtyomRevival.role: in-repository load-order and data separation reference only

absorbed.adaptation: The multi-part Exfil chain is condensed into four distinct operations. Admiral uses native SPT conditions, its own voice and its existing reward envelope; no Natalya trader, custom item, zone, armor, assort or dialogue is copied.
One distinct operation retains each useful capability theme. Six traders, WTT dependency, bundles, count ladders, map copies, imported IDs, rewards and dialogue are excluded.
Existing native table registration already implements the applicable structure. No custom router, compatibility layer or unrelated feature is added.

rejected.reason: Fourteen sequential map and target kill records duplicate native and Admiral elimination play and would restore a body-count ladder.
The accepted 21-record Arsenal baseline already owns weapon-family progression and unlocks.
A second trader, custom items, zones, armor, broad assort and source dialogue are unnecessary for the retained route concepts.
Wholesale traders, bundles and thousands of quests conflict with the single curated Admiral campaign and its no-filler rule.
Exact SPT 4.1.5 already contains target-specific quests for every ordinary boss role reviewed; another named boss kill has no distinct player decision or consequence.
Exact SPT 4.1.5 already contains cultist-role objectives, including Night of The Cult. A small night counter alone does not establish a distinct Admiral operation.
